description: The page document (WIRE_FORMAT.md 32, Phase 2522). SELF-ENUMERATED, so the directory is one corpus family (27.7): `page-document`. page-document-vectors.json carries accepted documents with their canonical bytes, demanded documents, content addresses and signing preimages (32.2, 32.4, 32.5), documents the codec refuses (32.3), documents the page-document validator mode refuses (32.6), and a read-set drift (32.5). A host that renders a page document runs every vector through its own codec and derivation and compares byte for byte; a host that renders none declares the family not applicable (32.8). Emitted by the reference host (fuaran-dotnet, FUARAN_REGEN=1 over Fuaran.UI.Tests).
